configuration.seed_policy: base + 100000*(instance-1) + 1000*R; bf_dcqo adds the internal iteration index
configuration.methodology: For each random instance and each R=1,...,30, start a new independent BF-DCQO run with zero bias and execute internal iterations r=1,...,R. Record RAW statistics only from the terminal internal iteration r=R. No greedy refinement is applied because s=0.
